excluded.evidence: op 'matrix' (a general matrix) has no single INSERT form: one INSERT carries translation, one rotation about the normal and three scales, and no shear. A three-level nested INSERT chain could carry its 2x2 part through a singular value decomposition, but those factors would be derived values compared under policy and not EXACT, and the probe's own truth is a rejection outcome that no reader-mapping check can exercise, so that was not attempted
